caption: Isaac v. Defendant 1
citation_line: Isaac v. Defendant 1, No. 3:25-cv-01325, ECF No. 11 (D.N.J. Dec. 30, 2025)
headnote_district_ruling: Denied alternative service through WhatsApp, NFTs, and a website for insufficient diligence in locating alleged foreign participants in a cryptocurrency 'pig-butchering' scheme, but allowed limited expedited KYC discovery from identified exchanges while rejecting account-balance and transaction-history requests.
qualification_rationale: A timely treatment of identity discovery, digital service, due process, and proportionality in cross-border cryptocurrency fraud litigation.
appellate_posture_note: Pre-service and nonparty-discovery order; no substantive appellate review identified.
subject_screen_exclusion_reason: Pre-service identity discovery and alternative-service ruling without a merits determination.
